annotations.text: Desktop, 1280 wide. Left to right: empty, notes pasted, preview estimate. The form sits in a 360px sidebar; results fill the rest.
Generating and results. Cards use an auto-fill grid, so the column count follows the window width rather than a breakpoint.
Below 900px the row collapses to a column and the sidebar stops being sticky.
Error states as they appear in the results column.
